pairs.subject: guided-tours
pairs.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:177 The component treats a missing anchor as 'drop the stop' with no per-step policy and no degradation record. Combined with Next-only advancement and a skip that forgets its step, three techniques fall short even though anchors, overlay conduct and focus are handled well.

techniques.evidence: apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:177 Absent anchors are filtered out under one global skip with no trace. The never-strand rule holds (no dimming; the mark and its Skip render whenever a view exists).
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:292 Every stop moves only on Next/Finish or the arrow keys, and no product signal is observed. Skip is always present.
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:197 Skip persists and stays closed (good), but it does not record which stop was abandoned. Reopen (line 135) is saved and survives reload.

apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tourAnchors.test.tsx:33 Drift gate: renders the real windows and resolves every stop with the same findAnchor the tour uses, with a reverse check at line 77. Geometry is re-resolved on resize, scroll, ResizeObserver and anchor-set changes (tour.tsx:206-225), and the anchor is scrolled into view (line 229).

apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:188 Hides while any sheet, popover or confirm is open on the layer stack. Uses the shared --z-popover token (tour.css:8) rather than its own number. The mark is a non-modal dialog with no focus trap, Esc skips (line 266), and focus goes back where it was (line 246).

apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.css:24 No audio. The only motion is a brief entrance plus position transitions, applied only when the owner has not asked for reduced motion. Nothing advances on animation end.
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:6 No performable motion to teach. The tour never presses product controls.
apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:159 Each window's short first-run tour, not a whole-product path over grouped navigation.

apps/desktop/client/src/shared/tour.tsx:218 Same-screen tour: measured on scroll, resize and ResizeObserver, with no route change to bridge. (Side note: the presence MutationObserver at line 183 watches all of document.body with subtree on, which the technique would call over-broad if it applied.)
